design_purpose.base_height: Offsets the stronger relief so the average valley stays near its previous elevation.
design_purpose.height_scale: Stronger rises and hollows break the long shallow terraces into more distinct landforms.
design_purpose.height_frequency: Slightly shorter hill spacing adds local silhouettes without enlarging the world.
design_purpose.height_octaves: Retains the existing three terrain detail scales.
design_purpose.height_warp_metres: Bends height contours sideways by up to 24 metres in noise space, not world-space displacement of blocks.
design_purpose.height_warp_frequency: Controls the breadth of those contour bends; resources and biomes regenerate on the resulting solid field.
